jobs.title: Technology Program Management, Associate / Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

Reports to the EIS Program Manager. As a Project Manager, responsible for managing specific efforts within the project portfolio and supporting one or more functional and/or cross-functional teams. Provides direct project management of IT and non-IT projects supporting strategic initiatives and regulatory requirements. Delivers a cross-functional change management role that requires interaction with management and key stakeholders across Technology and other impacted lines-of-business (LOB). At the project level, coordinates across the LOB delivery teams, technology and data management teams, Enterprise Information Security (EIS), the Technology Delivery Office (TDO) and Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO).
Responsibilities:
- Co-develop project plans with stakeholder leaders, identifying key milestones and deliverables.
- Schedules and facilitate stakeholder meetings, coordinating project plans and gaining consensus.
- Prepares reports, presentations, and other documentation as required by LOB stakeholders, the TDO and the EPMO.
- Produces and distributes status reporting on project progress, risks, issues, and dependencies.
- Ensures projects are on time.
- Conducts project deep-dive meetings with the TDO Program Manager to escalate risk/issues timely.
- Monitors project spending versus budget.
- Develops accurate project spending forecasts each month.
- Produces project documentation within the required timeframes in accordance with the standards and governance requirements of the IT Project Delivery (ITPD) Methodology, Project Spend and Governance Committee, and TDO guidelines.
- Work with IT teams to coordinate testing, escalate issues, and assist where necessary to ensure a successful go live.
- Coordinates the analysis of business problems including making recommendations to management to help identify methods, procedures, and technologies that enhance recommended solutions and project execution.

Requirements:
- A BA/BS degree and/or equivalent work experience
- Experience in Banking dealing with operations and technology change management, preferably in Finance
- Requires direct experience in business analysis and project leadership and management skills, preferably as a project manager or consultant
- Experience leading and managing projects from start to finish, including specific experience in tight timeline, and/or crisis environments
- PMP Certification preferred

Additional Qualifications:
- Must possess strong leadership skills and be very proactive in approach
- Ability to work independently
- Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and successfully
- Ability to quickly establish rapport, credibility, trust, and respect throughout the organization at all levels, and be viewed as a team player.
- Ability to lead through influence and garner support from and for cross functional teams.
- Excellent verbal and written skills, including the ability to communicate complex issues and ideas and communicate effectively within all levels of the organization within and outside of Finance
- Advanced PowerPoint and strong Excel skills
- Ability to organize and conduct effective meetings appropriate for the topic, and facilitate resolution of differing views
- Jira, Confluence and Power BI experience, a plus.

·         The typical base pay range for this role is between $93K - $123K depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. This role may also be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonuses and/or incentive compensation. Additionally, our Total Rewards program provides colleagues with a competitive benefits package (in accordance with the eligibility requirements and respective terms of each) that includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement plans, educational assistance and training programs, income replacement for qualified employees with disabilities, paid maternity and parental bonding leave, and paid vacation, sick days, and holidays. We're searching for a Treasury Relationship Manager responsible for a diversified portfolio composed mainly of Large Corporate and Mid-Corporate Japanese Corporate clients.  You will need to consult with highly complex clients and prospects, as well as internal coverage partners, on industry best practices related to core treasury and liquidity-related products as well as working capital solutions.

80% Business Development & Relationship/Account Management

- Leverage MUFG’s credit position and overall global banking relationship to identify cross-sell opportunities
- Execute specific management-driven strategies to enhance revenue and meet financial goals

- Analyze complex treasury arrangements, from which you will create proposals and pricing models.
- Perform routine pipeline management and sales tracking
- Recommend pricing and process exceptions at Large Deal Review committee
- Monitor and update company profiles to ensure adequate recordkeeping of bank relationships.
- Work with Product Management partners to enhance our current product set.

- Complete all required corporate and business line Compliance Trainings on time.
- Know client relationships deeply enough to identify potential suspicious activity.
- Escalate risk-related issues quickly and as appropriate.

The right candidate will have:
- 7-10 years’ experience in sales and relationship management, preferably at a well-known cash management provider either foreign or domestic
- Knowledge of advanced sales and marketing techniques, bank lending policies and practices, payment operations and services, and Federal and State banking regulations
- Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) accreditation a plus, but not required
- Japanese language skills a plus, but not required
- Strong knowledge of treasury management concepts and principles and ability to bring thought-leadership to the portfolio
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to close deals.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
- Flexibility to travel locally and regionally to client offices and conferences as required
- Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus

jobs.description:

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

Job Summary:
Portfolio management for designated customers. Responsible for the underwriting and portfolio management of Japanese Corporate loan portfolio clients. As focusing on subsidiary lending, designated customers will be complex relationships focusing on non-investment grade clients, customers with a large credit exposure, structured finance transactions, and customers with complex corporate structures.

Major Responsibilities:
Portfolio Management & Underwriting
- Perform due diligence and regularly scheduled credit reviews.

- Analyze credit risk of the designated portfolio, determine accurate ratings and make recommendations of accurate and timely ratings to management;  designated customers will be more complicated ones than those assigned to junior PMs, such as lower graded customers, customers with large credit exposure, customers with structured finance transactions, and customers with complex corporate structure.

- Prepare detailed credit analysis and credit applications in accordance with Bank’s credit policies and procedures such as Americas Credit Standards, Americas Credit-Related Procedures, Credit and JCB’s internal operating manuals, evaluating the borrower’s industry, business, legal and financial risks, and recommend extensions of credit.

- Manage deadlines and workload in accordance with the schedule.

- Function as a subject matter expert with regard to particular industries and industry subsectors.

- Fully understand and be able to assess risk of standard bank products including loans, standby letter of credit, trade finance, foreign exchange, derivatives, securitization, and lease.

- Interview the borrower’s senior management to assess their business/financial risks/challenges. Maintain direct communication with assigned customers, if needed by RM (relationship manager).

- Coordinate and communicate critical account information to various related parties throughout the bank.

- Oversee covenants compliance, facility due date, condition/instruction/report required, and call memos.

- Perform other risk related functions as needed.

Deal Support
- Work with business lines/product groups to identify prospective transactions.

- Lead new deals with moderate complexity for both existing and new customers from the credit underwriting perspective with moderate supervision. Experienced associates can identify structural risks and mitigants in prospective transactions and recommend/enhance structuring of deals and covenant in line with policies and procedures. Manager will periodically check in, however, associates can also make appropriate judgement when to escalate/consult with the manager where necessary.

- Advise account officers on credit risk issues, terms and conditions to craft the best possible deal with the goal of improving profit and minimizing credit cost.

- While closely consulting with manager, communicate with credit division/administration with regard to rating rationale, facility structuring/exposures and ensure credit division provided with all credit related information and analysis pertinent to making a decision.

Policy Compliance
- Ensure compliance with external regulatory requirements (JFSA, BOJ, FRB, OCC and FDIC).

- Ensure compliance with internal policy and procedures by understanding and adhering to Americas Credit Standards, Americas Credit-Related Procedures, Credit Rules, Procedures for Credit Ratings, JCB Operating Manual, and any other applicable pronouncements.

Support Dept. managers in credit risk management process .
- Support junior analysts on OJT basis as assigned by the manager (experienced associate).

- Study, develop and improve analytical skills through close communication with related divisions, such as Americas Credit Rivew, Credit departments, Credit Policy Office and other Credit Divisions with support from managers.

- Assist managers in the training efforts.

- Maintain and monitor compliance reporting requirements.

Qualifications
Requirements include:
- Ability to multi-task and work under high stress and time-sensitive work environment

- Strong time management skills; attentive to details for accuracy and integrity

- Strong organization skills and ability to manage multiple projects

- Proficient in MS Office including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Knowledge in banking applications is a plus.

- Sound knowledge in finance, accounting, legal, regulations for commercial banking products

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field such as accounting, finance.

- MBA/ CFA, a plus

- 3-5 years working experience in large financial institutions, credit and risk related function in equivalent organizations analyzing general corporate customers and making credit recommendations or other financial related roles such as M&A in accounting firms, business analysis in accounting/ consulting firms, analyzing subsidiaries performance in corporate finance function.

- Previous experiences including handling a segment of an industry vertical or a primarily investment grade commercial loan portfolio and coordinating with execution team for proper booking of newly assigned accounts, preferred.

- Japanese language skills

- Demonstrate innovative and strategic thinking

The typical base pay range for this role is between $90K - $121K depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and location. This role may also be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonus and/or incentive compensation. Additionally, our Total Rewards program provides colleagues with a competitive benefits package (in accordance with the eligibility requirements and respective terms of each) that includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement plans, educational assistance and training programs, income replacement for qualified employees with disabilities, paid maternity and parental bonding leave, and paid vacation, sick days, and holidays. For more information on our Total Rewards package, please click the link below.

About the Role
Position Title: Business Analyst, Capital Markets Group Support
Corporate Title: Analyst
Internal Title: Senior Analyst
Reporting to: Capital Markets Group
Location: Mumbai

Job Profile

Position details
The Business Analyst, Capital Markets Group Support will provide holistic business and related support to the Capital Markets Group (CMG), working closely with senior originators to enhance productivity across a broad range of capital markets activities.

The role is primarily responsible for assisting with the preparation of marketing materials, credit and industry research, data management, and other ad-hoc workstreams based on evolving business requirements.

Roles and Responsibilities

Marketing & Pitchbook Support
- Prepare, format, and maintain client pitchbooks, requests for proposal (RFPs), and other presentation materials.
- Ensure presentations adhere to internal branding, formatting, and quality standards.
- Convert technical and financial information into clear, professional presentation materials suitable for external discussions.
- Update and customize materials using internal resources, market intelligence, and precedents.
- Coordinate revisions and version control of presentations and supporting documents.

Market Research & Knowledge Management
- Assist with regular market updates covering loan, bond, and other relevant capital market developments.
- Build and maintain databases of precedent transactions, pricing benchmarks, and financing structures.
- Gather and analyse country, industry, and global macroeconomic data.
- Support knowledge-sharing initiatives across the CMG platform.

Credit & Transaction Analysis Support
- Support preparation of credit memos, internal committee papers, and other required workstreams.
- Conduct financial and credit analysis, including the review of financial statements, peer benchmarking and comparable analysis.

Team Support
- Work closely with senior originators to support ongoing business development and transaction execution activities.
- Assist with ad hoc projects and strategic initiatives as required.
- Support cross-product and cross-sector projects within the broader corporate and investment banking franchise.
- undefined

Job Requirements:

Education
- MBA/ CA or equivalent.
- Professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, or progress towards such qualifications would be advantageous.

Experience
- ·         2-4 years of experience in banking, capital markets, corporate finance, credit analysis, consulting, research, financial services, or a related analytical role.

Technical Skill:
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.·
- Advanced presentation formatting and production capabilities.·
- Ability to conduct financial analysis and interpret financial statements.·
- Experience with financial databases such as Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Refinitiv, Dealogic, or similar platforms is advantageous.
-

Core Competencies ·

The primary purpose of this role is to ensure that First Line of Defence ("FLOD") related regulatory obligations are met with a focus on Know Your Client ("KYC") / Quality Control ("QC") / Quality Assurance ("QA") programs. The Assistant Vice President (AVP) will be responsible for supervising end-to-end KYC due diligence process and for developing, implementing and maintaining operating manuals and procedures across functions with an emphasis on Global Corporate & Investment Banking ("GCIB") and Japanese Corporate & Investment Banking ("JCIB") clients. The AVP will also act as a Subject Matter Expert ("SME") for FLOD KYC onboardings, and periodic and adhoc review processes and work closely with Compliance, Risk and other departments, such as GCIB and JCIB teams, to operate in line with the Bank's overall goals and strategies.

KYC FLOD SME:
- Lead local strategy implementation and effectiveness of the Bank's KYC FLOD related programs (including onboarding, periodic and adhoc reviews, QC, QA)
- Ensure that all KYC review files meet the highest quality standard
- Lead development, implementation and maintenance of relevant processes, standards, reports, procedures and operating manuals
- Maintain, track and act as subject matter expert on platforms, subscriptions, Service Level Agreements ("SLA") specific to the Client Management Unit ("CMU") and other Business Units

Risk & Control:
- Lead execution support for risk and control responsibilities related to Second Line of Defence ("SLOD") risk frameworks and Regulatory Compliance assessment requirements
- Provide execution support for the Issues Management Framework including the identification, remediation planning, ongoing monitoring and closure validation of open issues, and collaborate for issues resolution in a timely manner
- Responsible for monitoring and reporting to ensure integration with risk, compliance, and operational aspects of the Bank to ensure ongoing compliance with changing regulations and requirements

Stakeholder Management:
- Support GCIB and JCIB customers on-boarding process and other customer-related requests with an emphasis on excellence in client service
- Develop a strong and productive working relationship with FLODs
- Liaise and coordinate relationships with local Compliance Department and Internal Audit, Testing teams and Global Financial Crimes Division (non-domestic)
- Act as SME for various cross-functional and enterprise-wide projects and manage relationships with multiple stakeholders at all levels

Process/Quality Improvement:
- Apply knowledge of all current applicable regulatory obligations focusing on Corporate Banking, and be able to relate them to policies and procedures
- Provide KYC FLOD related training to relevant stakeholders
Continuous assessment of KYC FLOD programs and process improvement
- Perform other duties as required and assigned including active participation in auxiliary tasks such as Business Unit Reporting and Risk Management, Risk & Control Self-Assessment, Inbound Due Diligence Reporting, Records & Information Management, Global Financial Crimes Risk Assessment, Billing & Revenue reporting and other similar initiatives which may arise from time to time.

Qualifications
- 5+ years of working experience in the Financial Industry with solid understanding of Corporate Banking
- Solid knowledge of KYC / AML / QC / QA and Regulatory Compliance
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment/ multitasking/ independently
- Proficient with policy analysis and procedure writing
- Undergraduate University Degree in Finance, Economics or related field
- CAMS designation preferred
- Proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint. General IT / systems knowledge
- Analytical approach to performing complex and varied tasks
- Influential / leadership communications skills (verbal and written), critical thinking skills, business process / analysis skills, documentation skills
- High risk management skills and project management skills

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

MUFG is an expert in project finance, supporting clients in acquiring, building, or recapitalizing assets areas including the energy, natural resources, transportation, social infrastructure, digital infrastructure and power sectors. We have one of the most active project finance businesses in the world and have consistently been ranked the #1 overall project finance bank in the Americas since 2009.

The project finance team actively originate, structure, and execute debt project financing transactions. Project finance transactions include bank loan arranging, senior notes placement or bookrunning, institutional loan bookrunning, and project finance advisory services. Transactions often also involve interest rate and currency derivatives. The team works closely with dedicated partners in MUFG’s debt capital markets and global markets teams to seamlessly deliver debt financing and risk management solutions for clients across markets.

This position will be responsible for originating and structuring financing for specific large-scale energy and infrastructure projects for corporate and government clients or long-term alternative energy related projects. Financing structures will vary depending on client requirements. We are seeking a seasoned manager with extensive product knowledge and expertise. Role is balanced between day-to-day high level operational execution and development of the strategic direction of the relevant Infrastructure area.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct marketing activities for project finance, identifying and sourcing lending and non-lending (cross selling) opportunities that conform to MUFG’s business opportunities.
- Conduct credit analyses and due diligence on new business opportunities Guide the deals through closing and ensure a smooth transition to the portfolio group.
- Refer business to MUFG US
- Perform related duties and participate in special projects as required by MD.

Qualifications:
- 10+ yrs project finance experience in leading the origination and structuring of deals placed in the commercial bank market, institutional loan market and 144A/USPP market
- Experience should include the natural resource (midstream, LNG, petrochemical, refining) and new energies (alternative fuels, carbon capture) sectors
- Leading project finance advisory
- A Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
- Familiarity with the “big picture”, anticipating workflow rather than acting reactively.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Capacity to consistently communicate professionally, tactfully, and effectively with clients, third-party advisors, and colleagues.
- Demonstrated ability to work under pressure in a high-intensity environment and effectively manage/prioritize and deliver on multiple streams of workflow while maintaining a high degree of attention to detail and accuracy in all respects.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

Role Purpose
The Regional Program Manager will lead selected major cross-branch and cross-regional programs where ownership is broad, delivery is complex, and strong regional orchestration is required. The role provides end-to-end program and project leadership from early planning and mobilization through execution, implementation and closure.
The incumbent will work across branches, business and service owners, technology departments, PMO functions, Head Office stakeholders, vendors and external partners to establish clear ownership, integrated plans, effective governance, proactive risk management and transparent management reporting. Once assigned, the Regional Program Manager is accountable for the same core project management disciplines expected of other Project Managers, with the key distinction being the strategic, regional and multi-entity nature of the assigned initiatives.
- Strategically important initiatives with regional CIO, HOD or senior-management visibility.
- Cross-branch, cross-regional or cross-entity programs requiring coordinated planning and execution.
- Programs with unclear early ownership, multiple delivery parties, or significant interdependencies.
- Major new system implementations, branch launch or refresh programs, regional transformation initiatives, and other high-risk or high-complexity programs.
- Initiatives requiring structured program mobilization, integrated governance, escalation management and executive-level reporting.

Job Responsibilities
Program Leadership and Delivery
- Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of assigned major programs and projects, ensuring agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality and outcomes are achieved.
- Develop and maintain the integrated program charter, roadmap, master plan, work breakdown structure, milestones, dependencies and delivery cadence.
- Establish clear ownership across workstreams and ensure accountable owners are assigned for business, technology, branch readiness, testing, migration, change and implementation activities.
- Manage program execution through implementation and closure, ensuring decisions, actions and deliverables are completed on time.
- Act as the primary escalation point for critical program risks, issues, dependencies and delivery roadblocks.

Upstream Planning and Program Mobilization
- Engage during concept and planning stages to translate high-level management direction into an executable program structure.
- Clarify program objectives, scope, success measures, sponsorship, governance forums, decision rights and stakeholder responsibilities.
- Prepare integrated resource, financial, procurement, vendor, communications and implementation plans in collaboration with accountable functions.
- Identify cross-branch and cross-regional implications early and drive alignment before formal execution begins.

Stakeholder and Executive Management
- Build effective working relationships with senior management, branches, service owners, business teams, ITD/TIS/IRMD, PMO functions, Head Office, vendors and external partners.
- Facilitate steering committees, working groups, decision forums and cross-entity alignment discussions.
- Present concise, decision-oriented updates to sponsors and management, highlighting status, risks, financial position, dependencies, decisions required and recommended actions.
- Influence stakeholders across organizational and geographic boundaries and resolve conflicting priorities constructively.

Governance, Risk and Change Control
- Ensure assigned programs comply with the ASO Project Management Standard, project governance requirements, approval processes and applicable policies.
- Maintain robust RAID, change control, decision and dependency management disciplines throughout the program lifecycle.
- Partner with Regional PMO Governance and relevant department or branch PMOs for phase-gate reviews, baseline monitoring, exception handling and audit readiness.
- Ensure program information, plans, deliverables and status are maintained accurately in APH and approved repositories.
- Drive timely mitigation and escalation of operational, regulatory, technology, financial, schedule and delivery risks.

Financial, Resource and Vendor Management
- Develop and monitor program budgets, forecasts, expenditure, resource plans and financial risks in coordination with Finance, Procurement and accountable owners.
- Coordinate internal and external resource requirements across workstreams, branches and delivery partners.
- Manage vendor deliverables, dependencies, performance, contractual obligations and escalation points in partnership with Procurement and service owners.
- Identify capacity constraints and recommend prioritization, sequencing or intervention actions to management.

Leadership and Delivery Excellence
- Promote accountability, collaboration, transparency and disciplined execution across program teams.
- Provide direction and coaching to Project Managers, PMO resources and workstream leads assigned to the program.
- Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement of Regional PMO practices, templates, tools and governance processes.
- Support portfolio-level reviews, strategic planning and management interventions for other major initiatives when required.

Job Requirements
- Minimum 12 years of experience in program management, project management, transformation delivery or a comparable complex delivery role in the financial industry, with stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, and regional teams .
- Proven experience leading large-scale, multi-workstream programs involving multiple countries, branches, business functions, technology teams, PMOs and external partners.
- Demonstrated ownership of full project and program lifecycle delivery, including planning, governance, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, vendors, implementation and closure.
- Experience preparing and presenting executive-level program updates, recommendations and decision papers.
- Strong understanding of project and program management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile and hybrid delivery approaches.
- Experience working in a complex matrix organization and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance or a related discipline.
- Experience in banking, financial services or another regulated industry.
- Experience delivering regional or cross-border technology and business transformation programs across Asia Pacific.
- Professional certification such as PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, PMI-ACP or an equivalent recognized qualification.
- Master’s degree or MBA.
- Experience using project portfolio and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Microsoft Planner, Power BI, Microsoft 365 or Jira.

This role combines deep business-domain expertise with broad technology leadership. The successful candidate will serve as the senior technology partner to Operations and business leadership, owning service stability, regulatory delivery, technology risk, platform strategy, organisational leadership and engineering transformation. A key aspect of the role is driving the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering to enhance delivery effectiveness, quality and operational resilience.

About MUFG

Discover your opportunity with MUFG, one of the world's leading financial institutions. Our purpose is to contribute to society through trusted financial services, long-term relationships and sustainable growth.

At MUFG, we combine global scale with a commitment to innovation, collaboration and inclusion. We invest in our people, technology and platforms to create meaningful impact for clients, communities and colleagues.

The Opportunity

This is a high-profile leadership role responsible for technology supporting core Global Markets Operations capabilities across EMEA and selected Corporate Banking Operations functions.

Success requires a leader who can operate credibly at both executive and technical levels. You will influence business strategy, shape investment decisions, oversee a complex technology estate and lead transformation across a globally distributed organisation.

You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across Operations, Front Office, Technology, Risk, Compliance and executive management while leading an organisation of approximately 40-50 professionals across London, India and New York.

Scope of Role

- End-to-end technology ownership for critical Global Markets post-trade and back-office services.
- Strategic technology partner to senior Operations and business leadership.
- Leadership of a multi-disciplinary organisation spanning production support, engineering and change delivery across London, India and New York.
- Accountability for a mixed estate of strategic vendor platforms and internally developed applications.
- Ownership of service resilience, operational risk, regulatory delivery and technology modernisation.
- Delivery of business, regulatory and lifecycle change across a complex and interconnected technology landscape.
- Leadership of AI-enabled engineering transformation and productivity initiatives.
- Ownership of technology budgets, investment priorities, vendor relationships and resource strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Business Partnership
- Act as the trusted technology advisor to senior Global Markets Operations and Corporate Banking stakeholders.
- Provide technology leadership across core post-trade and operational capabilities including securities settlement, collateral management, liquidity and cash management, reconciliations, transaction reporting, confirmation matching and asset servicing.
- Translate business strategy, regulatory obligations and operational priorities into clear technology investment and execution plans.
- Build strong relationships across business, operations and technology functions, influencing outcomes at senior executive level.
- Represent Back Office Technology across governance, investment, risk and transformation forums.
- Provide concise executive reporting on service health, delivery performance, technology risk and investment priorities.

Strategy, Architecture and Roadmaps
- Define and execute a multi-year technology strategy across the Global Markets Operations technology estate and supporting Corporate Banking Operations platforms.
- Drive simplification, resilience, modernisation and technical debt reduction across a diverse estate of vendor and internally developed platforms.
- Shape technology roadmaps supporting regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, business growth and cost optimisation.
- Partner with Architecture, Infrastructure, Cyber Security and Data teams to ensure alignment with enterprise technology strategy.
- Promote platform rationalisation, automation and simplification while reducing operational complexity and risk.

Platform and Service Ownership
- Accountable for service availability, resilience, performance and operational supportability across the technology estate.
- Establish strong service ownership, monitoring, support models and operational controls.
- Lead major incident response, root-cause analysis and sustainable remediation.
- Drive continuous improvement through automation, observability and elimination of manual operational processes.
- Ensure robust disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities across critical services.

Delivery and Change Leadership
- Lead delivery of regulatory, strategic, risk and business initiatives across the portfolio.
- Ensure clear governance, prioritisation and execution across programmes and projects.
- Drive process improvement, automation and straight-through processing.
- Manage dependencies across vendors, business functions, market infrastructure providers and global programmes.
- Make clear, risk-based prioritisation decisions where demand exceeds capacity.

MUFG is seeking a Vice President to join the Portfolio Management Group (PMG) within the Sponsor, Growth & Middle Market (SGMM) Healthcare vertical. This role is responsible for the underwriting and portfolio management of sponsor-backed and corporate healthcare borrowers.

The Vice President will manage a designated portfolio of middle market healthcare credits, lead the underwriting and execution of new transactions, oversee ongoing portfolio monitoring, and ensure compliance with internal credit policies and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will combine strong credit analysis and portfolio management capabilities with leadership responsibilities, serving as a key partner to Relationship Managers, Credit Division, product groups, sponsors, borrowers, and internal control functions. The Vice President will also mentor junior team members and contribute to the continued enhancement of portfolio management processes and risk management frameworks.

Responsibilities:

Portfolio Management

- Manage a portfolio of sponsor-backed and corporate healthcare clients, including periodic credit reviews, ongoing risk assessment, and performance monitoring.

- Analyze borrower operating performance, liquidity, leverage, cash flow generation, and debt repayment capacity to identify potential upgrades, downgrades, emerging risks, and opportunities.

- Determine accurate internal and regulatory risk ratings and make timely rating recommendations to management.

- Maintain direct communication with borrowers, sponsors, Relationship Managers, and internal stakeholders regarding portfolio developments.

- Monitor healthcare industry trends, market developments, reimbursement dynamics, regulatory changes, and competitive positioning relevant to portfolio companies.

- Coordinate and communicate portfolio account information across Credit, Relationship Management, Product Partners, Operations, Compliance, and Senior Management.

- Prepare portfolio reporting, management presentations, and ad hoc analyses for senior stakeholders.

- Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory guidance, and portfolio management procedures.

Underwriting & Deal Execution

- Evaluate and underwrite leveraged buyouts (LBOs), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), recapitalizations, refinancings, add-on acquisitions, growth financings, and other complex lending transactions within the healthcare sector.

- Build and review detailed financial models, including base case, downside case, and sensitivity analyses.

- Prepare comprehensive credit approval memoranda addressing business risk, industry dynamics, sponsor support, transaction structure, financial performance, projections, valuation, key risks, and mitigants.

- Identify structural risks and recommend appropriate covenant protections, deal structuring enhancements, and risk mitigants consistent with bank policies.

- Partner with Relationship Managers, product specialists, and Credit Division throughout underwriting, approval, and closing processes.

- Participate in client, sponsor, lender, and internal credit meetings as required.

- Review legal documentation and coordinate closing activities to ensure transactions are executed accurately and efficiently.

Transaction Administration & Portfolio Infrastructure

- Maintain oversight of credit administration processes and ensure completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of portfolio documentation.

- Review and interpret legal documentation to capture key economic and structural terms including pricing, fees, maturity profiles, collateral provisions, and covenant requirements.

- Coordinate with Operations, Middle Office, Legal, KYC, Enterprise Value, and other control functions to facilitate successful transaction closings and portfolio maintenance.

- Ensure credit applications, reviews, and portfolio records comply with internal standards, regulatory expectations, and documentation requirements.

- Maintain integrity of portfolio databases and internal systems used for reporting, monitoring, and risk management.

- Support management reporting through accurate portfolio data collection, validation, and analysis.

Leadership & Team Development

- Provide guidance, oversight, and mentorship to Associates and Analysts across underwriting and portfolio management activities.

- Review credit analyses, financial models, risk ratings, and written materials prepared by junior professionals.

- Assist in training team members on credit risk management best practices, underwriting standards, portfolio monitoring methodologies, and healthcare sector knowledge.

- Contribute to process improvements and initiatives designed to strengthen portfolio management practices, risk governance, and analytical capabilities across the Healthcare vertical.

Skills & Experience:

- Bachelor's degree required; degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field preferred.

- MBA and/or CFA designation considered a plus.

- 7+ years of experience in commercial banking, leveraged finance, sponsor finance, corporate banking, private credit, credit risk management, or related financial services roles.

- Significant experience underwriting and managing corporate credit exposure to middle market and sponsor-backed companies.

- Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred.

- Strong understanding of corporate finance, accounting, leveraged lending, and credit risk fundamentals.

- Advanced financial modeling and cash flow analysis capabilities.

- Knowledge of healthcare subsectors, reimbursement frameworks, regulatory dynamics, and industry-specific credit considerations is a plus.

jobs.description:

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

Keywords: transaction banking, treasury solutions, cash management, liquidity management, trade finance, client relationship management, regulatory compliance, business development, cross-selling, stakeholder collaboration

MUFG is seeking to appoint a Regional Treasury and Trade Solutions Manager within its esteemed Transaction Banking division in London. This role presents an unparalleled opportunity for you to assume a central position in advancing the future of transaction banking throughout the United Kingdom and the broader EMEA region. You will be entrusted with delivering sophisticated treasury, cash, liquidity, and trade finance solutions to a diverse array of multinational clients. The organisation fosters a collegial environment where your expertise will have a direct bearing on business expansion, client satisfaction, and strategic direction. With access to advanced digital platforms and a supportive network comprising product, sales, implementation, and risk professionals, you will benefit from the latitude to introduce meaningful enhancements. If you are committed to cultivating enduring client relationships, adept at navigating intricate regulatory frameworks, and eager to contribute within a high-performing team, this appointment offers an exceptional platform for your continued professional growth.

* Become part of a globally acclaimed financial institution renowned for its leadership in transaction banking across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa—offering you exposure to international markets and exemplary industry standards.
* Experience a culture that places great value on knowledge sharing, continuous professional development, and cross-functional collaboration—enabling you to refine your skills while making a substantive contribution to organisational objectives.
* Benefit from flexible working arrangements within a London-based team that supports both domestic and international clients through innovative digital channels and comprehensive treasury offerings.

What you'll do:

In the capacity of Regional Treasury and Trade Solutions Manager within Transaction Banking, you will be responsible for overseeing a varied portfolio of corporate clients who depend upon your acumen for their treasury requirements. Your daily remit will encompass identifying new commercial prospects through close cooperation with coverage partners whilst nurturing established relationships to maximise revenue generation. You will devise tailored strategies for each client by leveraging market intelligence alongside advanced product expertise. Your proficiency in coordinating multidisciplinary teams ensures seamless delivery of sophisticated solutions that address evolving regulatory imperatives. By championing exemplary pipeline management practices and cross-selling initiatives, you will assist in diversifying income streams whilst upholding rigorous compliance standards. Furthermore, your dedication to knowledge dissemination will foster continual professional development within the team—ensuring all members remain abreast of industry advancements.

* Cultivate business development by originating complex treasury, trade, and working capital financing solutions for clients situated in the United Kingdom as well as Switzerland, non-EU jurisdictions, and other regions encompassed by the global network.
* Enhance revenues from existing clients by optimising returns from cash management, liquidity management, and trade financing services within your assigned portfolio.
* Collaborate closely with coverage partners across EMEA to identify new business opportunities with both prospective clients and those already engaged with the institution, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.
* Formulate and implement bespoke client strategies for your portfolio by engaging in account planning, wallet progression analysis, and solution identification in concert with product specialists.
* Exemplify best practices in pipeline management by achieving individual targets across all cash and liquidity management products while serving as a model for colleagues within the wider team.
* Broaden revenue streams by promoting the full suite of cash management, liquidity management, and trade finance products rather than focusing solely on single-product sales.
* Lead responses to complex regional and global RFIs/RFPs by orchestrating input from multiple functions across transaction banking to deliver compelling proposals.
* Foster robust working relationships with key stakeholders including product teams, client implementation specialists, risk managers, coverage bankers, compliance officers, legal advisors, and others both within EMEA and globally.
* Serve as the first line of defence for compliance, legal, and risk matters related to cash and liquidity management transactions within your portfolio; proactively escalate issues and contribute to ongoing enhancement of risk frameworks.
* Provide guidance or training to colleagues and internal stakeholders to elevate understanding of cash management concepts and enhance overall sales effectiveness.

What you bring:

To excel as Regional Treasury and Trade Solutions Manager in Transaction Banking you will possess substantial practical experience acquired at leading financial institutions where you have managed intricate portfolios involving cash management or trade finance. Your background encompasses building trusted partnerships with multinational corporates whilst navigating evolving regulatory landscapes across Europe & Asia. You bring deep technical proficiency spanning payment platforms (ERP/TMS/SWIFT), liquidity optimisation tools & digital channels—enabling you to design bespoke solutions that address unique client requirements. Your interpersonal strengths are evident when collaborating with cross-functional teams or presenting at industry forums; clarity underpins every interaction whether preparing detailed proposals or facilitating stakeholder workshops. Analytical rigour allows you to distil extensive information into pragmatic recommendations that drive mutual value creation. A commitment to lifelong learning ensures you remain current on market developments & regulatory changes—while your mentoring approach contributes positively to collective capability.

* Extensive experience at Vice President level or equivalent in cash management, liquidity management, trade finance sales or origination within a Tier 1 global financial institution is essential for success in this role.
* Proven record of adapting effectively to diverse operating environments and market conditions whilst consistently delivering revenue growth over multiple business cycles.
* Demonstrated expertise in managing senior-level relationships with global corporate or multinational clients within comparable roles focused on cash management or trade finance.
* Comprehensive subject matter expertise in payments systems (including ERP integration), electronic banking connectivity (SWIFT/File Formats), liquidity products (pooling/optimisation), as well as emerging technology trends impacting transaction banking.
* In-depth understanding of European/UK regulatory frameworks such as Basel IV, PSD2, ISO20022, MIFID II/CRDVI along with awareness of competitive landscape across Europe & Asia markets.
* Ability to structure creative solutions addressing complex payment/collection challenges while balancing risk considerations across credit/legal/compliance domains.
* Advanced communication skills enabling effective engagement at all organisational levels—both internally (written/verbal/presentations) & externally (industry/client events).
* Strong analytical capabilities allowing aggregation & interpretation of complex data sets into actionable insights that benefit both bank & client objectives.
* Experience participating actively in business/credit committee reviews; able to present cases clearly & persuasively before senior decision-makers.
* Minimum BA/BSc degree required in Finance/Business/Economics or related discipline or equivalent work experience
; professional treasury qualifications (e.g., ACT) are highly desirable.

What sets MUFG apart:

This institution distinguishes itself as one of the world’s most esteemed financial organisations with an enduring reputation for excellence in transaction banking services. Its London office serves as a nexus for innovation—connecting clients globally through state-of-the-art digital platforms designed for efficiency and security. Employees benefit from an inclusive culture that prioritises professional advancement via structured training programmes and mentorship opportunities; knowledge sharing is integral so all may learn from one another’s experiences. Flexible working arrangements support work-life balance whilst fostering collaboration among diverse teams drawn from many backgrounds. The company’s commitment to responsible banking is reflected not only in its rigorous compliance standards but also its proactive stance towards sustainability and community engagement—making it an employer of choice for those seeking purpose-driven careers alongside commercial achievement.

What's next:

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

Job Description

Overall Purpose of Job:
Primary support for evaluating and underwriting Direct Loans and other credit exposures to Private Equity owned non-investment grade borrowers ranging in size from middle market to large corporate within the Sponsor Finance & Direct Lending business unit. Associates will also provide support for the Originations (Financial Sponsor coverage), Syndications, Monitoring and Sponsor portfolio company Relationship Management functions by assignment within the business unit.

Associates will be a corporate finance professional, supporting Sponsor Finance & Direct Lending including non-investment grade transaction origination and credit analysis efforts. Critical functions include assessing risk factors associated with each credit and determining the appropriate risk ratings based on established policies and guidelines. Responsibilities will include active credit management and monitoring for potential upgrades, downgrades or general credit deterioration with the goal of maximizing the bank’s net income while minimizing credit costs.

Responsibilities:
- Support the credit analysis and management of the Sponsor/Direct Lending business unit
- Perform due diligence on new transactions as well as regularly scheduled evaluation of the existing loan portfolio
- Provide support for evaluating, structuring and negotiating terms and credit agreements with Sponsor clients
- Support the preparation of detailed credit analyses and required credit applications in accordance with internal policies and regulatory guidance, including the evaluation of company-specific, industry, and regulatory risks; and company historical operating performance, projected operating performance and capital structure.
- Modeling skills required for both the credit application process and quarterly review presentations.
- Provide support for coverage team’s idea generation and pitch books for Sponsor clients and potential clients and attend client meetings as required
- Provide support for the syndication strategy, including lender presentations and liaison with participant lenders, including banks and private credit firms
- Responsible for the coordination and communication of account information across various constituencies throughout the organization.
- Generalist coverage responsibilities including the need to understand current relevant industry conditions in assigned portfolio utilizing internal and external sources.
- Oversight of facility closing procedures including both operations and documentation.

Advanced Client Solutions:
- Work within deal team environment (with GRM, Corporate Advisory, Capital Markets, and Syndications) supporting the development and analysis of financing structures/strategies, including leveraged capital markets and other product areas.
- Support credit analysis for structured credit transactions (derivatives transactions, margin lending, receivable securitizations, supply chain finance).
- Understand and maintain knowledge of industries represented in portfolio, including technical aspects and regulatory issues.
- Participate in client and bank meetings as necessary.

Policy and Transaction Responsibilities:
- Support the communication with the credit approval division including final hold level strategies to ensure alignment of risk strategy and policy.
- Evaluate and establish appropriate ratings for transactions and correlate appropriate exposure level with regard to exposure on both a transaction and group level.
- Ensure compliance with policy and regulatory requirements.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree, CFA candidacy is a plus.
- 2+ years of work experience in financial institutions or equivalent credit risk related function analyzing corporate customers
- Strong financial modeling skills
- Knowledge of accounting and corporate finance
- Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills
- Good computer skills in Microsoft Word, Power Point, and Excel.
- Able to work independently and under pressure.

The typical base pay range for this role is depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, level and location and is between $110k-$175k base. This role may also be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonus and/or incentive compensation. Additionally, our Total Rewards program provides colleagues with a competitive benefits package (in accordance with the eligibility requirements and respective terms of each) that includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement plans, educational assistance and training programs, income replacement for qualified employees with disabilities, paid maternity and parental bonding leave, and paid vacation, sick days, and holidays. About MUFG Bank (Europe) N.V.
MUFG Bank (Europe) N.V. (MBE) is a fully-owned subsidiary of MUFG Bank, headquartered in Amsterdam. Function positioning
You will provide relationship management in the broadest sense, including the origination of products and services for financial sponsors and specialist lenders in the Financial Institutions client portfolio of MUFG Bank Europe with a focus on the Benelux and Nordic regions.

The role includes the following responsibilities:
- Providing support to the product and sector teams based in London for relationship management of financial sponsors and specialist lenders based in the Benelux an, where applicable, Nordics region.
- Identifying and onboarding those financial sponsors and specialist lenders based in Benelux and where applicable Nordics region in compliance with the local rules and regulations .
- Enhancing cross sell of products with existing and new clients to increase number of products per client.
- Supervising and managing direct reports effectively and efficiently.
- Contributing to the innovation of products and services and simplification of the procedures of the Bank.

In order to be successful in the role, you will need the following:
- Proven business development and relationship management experience working with financial sponsors, structured finance providers and specialist lenders.
- Proven experience as a product specialist in the execution of structured finance products, including subscription lines, NAV facilities and ABS transactions for financial sponsors and specialist lenders.
- University degree in a relevant discipline.
- Preferably qualifications and courses related to the structured finance or project finance transactions.
- Ability to manage complex transactions in the credit- and infrastructure funds space.
- Solid understanding and experience in working with financial models and analysis of asset-based structures in the credit and infrastructure funds.
- Excellent communication skills.
- Strong problem solving and interpersonal skills.

Personal requirements:
Integrity and Responsibility:
- Balance Risk with Opportunity
- Customer Focus
- Demonstrate Global Perspective

Professionalism and Teamwork:
- Drive For Results
- Collaborate and Build Partnerships
- Communicate Effectively and Professionally

Challenge Ourselves To Grow:
- Influence and Inspire Others
- Lead Change & Seek Continuous Improvement
- Think Strategically
- Manage and Develop Talent

What do we have to offer:

We offer you a role in one of the largest banks of the world in a growing and international environment.  You have various opportunities to develop yourself and we will support you with that by offering various training and development possibilities.
- We take into account your home situation and your ambitions and help you to balance work and private life.
- Monthly team events.
- To work in an ambitious, international environment with colleagues from different countries and cultures, who strive for the best.

Besides that we will offer you:
- Gross salary based on experience and consistent with the market
- 8% holiday allowance and 13th month payment.
- 30 vacation days per year. Optional you can buy 15 additional days.
- Commuting allowance based on annual public transport 2nd class, most economical way, or € 0,23 per km with a max of 75km one way.
- €5,00 net remote working compensation per day, with a maximum of €60,00 per month.

- Possibility to order Office Equipment’s for the home office, (up to €500,-)
- Remote Working Policy i.e. Working From Home (WFH) and Remote Working in another Country.

- Company fitness (fiscal benefit)
- Mental health workshops and budget for external courses (i.e. Dutch language classes).

The successful candidate will partner closely with business, product, operations, compliance, and risk management stakeholders to help strengthen the overall risk and control environment. This individual will contribute to the execution of the business unit's risk management framework, ensuring risks are proactively identified, appropriately assessed, and effectively controlled in alignment with regulatory expectations and organizational risk appetite.

- Support management presentations and governance forums through the preparation of risk reporting, analysis, and executive-level materials.
- Participate in regulatory, audit, and internal review activities by providing risk documentation, analysis, and stakeholder coordination.
- Contribute to strategic risk and control initiatives aimed at enhancing governance, streamlining processes, and improving risk transparency across the organization.
- Stay informed on industry best practices and evolving risk management methodologies to support continuous improvement within the Business Unit Risk & Control function.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Risk Management, Accounting, or a related discipline.
- Previous experience in risk management, operational risk, controls, audit, compliance, corporate banking, investment banking, or a related financial services function.
- Foundational understanding of banking products, operational risk frameworks, and control management principles.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information effectively to diverse audiences.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

Restaurant & Hospitality Finance (RHF) is a rapidly expanding initiative within MUFG’s Global Corporate & Investment Banking Group.  The team finances larger restaurant and fitness sector Franchisors, Operating Companies and Franchisees, with particular focus on Quick Service, Fast Casual and High-Value Low-Price national brands. Analyst will be a corporate finance professional, supporting Restaurant & Hospitality Finance including non-investment grade transaction origination and credit analysis efforts. - Modeling skills required for both the credit application process and quarterly review presentations.
- Provide support for coverage team’s idea generation and pitch materials for Sponsor clients and potential clients and attend client meetings as required
- Provide support for the syndication strategy, including lender presentations and liaison with participant lenders, including banks and private credit firms
- Responsible for the coordination and communication of account information across various constituencies throughout the organization.

Primary support for evaluating and underwriting Direct Loans and other credit exposures to Private Equity owned non-investment grade borrowers ranging in size from middle market to large corporate within the Sponsor, Growth & Middle Market - Healthcare industry vertical and business unit. Analysts will also provide support for the Originations (Financial Sponsor coverage), Syndications, Monitoring/Portfolio Management and Sponsor portfolio company Relationship Management functions by assignment within the business unit.

- Provide support for the syndication strategy, including lender presentations and liaison with participant lenders, including banks and private credit firms

- Generalist coverage responsibilities including the need to understand current relevant industry conditions in assigned portfolio utilizing internal and external sources.
- Oversight of facility closing procedures including both operations and documentation.

- Understand and maintain knowledge of industries represented in portfolio, including technical aspects and regulatory issues.
- Participate in client and bank meetings as necessary.

Corporate and Investment Banking covers two specialisms within our business – Global Corporate and Investment Banking products.
Our coverage team is responsible for building strong client relationships to ensure we provide the best possible service.  To do this, our coverage teams need to develop an in-depth understanding of a client’s business, their needs and how MUFG can best help them.

On the Product side, we have a number of different teams, each of which specialises in a specific financing product such as Aviation, Commodity Finance, Corporate Advisory, Leveraged Finance, Project Finance and Securitisation.

What to expect
Our 18-month Analyst Programme begins with a comprehensive training curriculum designed to build your understanding of our products, clients, and business strategy. This foundation will equip you with the knowledge and confidence needed to succeed as you transition into your role.
As part of a select Analyst cohort, you'll learn from some of the most experienced professionals in the industry while building connections with peers across the programme.

Our collaborative culture encourages teamwork, while also creating opportunities for you to make your own impact. In our open and inclusive environment, senior colleagues are approachable, invested in your development, and eager to support your growth. In addition, your buddy and mentor will make sure you have all the support you need to succeed.  And you’ll enjoy an ongoing commitment to your development as you build a lasting and rewarding career with us.

Join our Team
We look for talented, motivated and ambitious people who will be able to help drive our business forward. Successful candidates will:
- Have a strong interest in financial markets
- Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Have high levels of motivation and integrity
- Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Have excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Be innovative and have the ability to generate new and creative ideas
- Be in their final year of study or have graduated in the last 12 months

Additional information
The programme starts on 19 July 2027 with a 5-week entry training at EMEA headquarters in London. Following the entry training, analysts will return to Madrid to complete the rest of the programme and on-desk rotations.

A leading global financial institution is seeking a Vice President to join their Debt Capital Markets team in Singapore. This role offers you the opportunity to play a pivotal part in helping clients access global debt markets, while supporting senior originators and contributing to a sustainable, client-focused business across the region. You will be empowered to develop value-added relationships with key clients, work closely with relationship managers, and deliver high-quality support and product interface regarding capital markets financing opportunities. The organisation is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where your expertise is valued, and you are encouraged to collaborate across teams for both personal and professional growth. With flexible working opportunities and ongoing training, this position provides a platform for you to expand your network, enhance your skills, and make a meaningful impact within a supportive leadership structure.

- Play a central role in origination, structuring, and execution of debt transactions for local, regional, and global capital markets, ensuring smooth deal processes from mandate to closing.

- Build direct client relationships with a capital markets focus by providing high-quality support and product interface on financing opportunities across multiple debt products and currencies.

- Benefit from flexible working arrangements, continuous training opportunities, and a knowledgeable team that values collaboration, inclusivity, and growth leadership.

What you'll do:
As Vice President, Debt Capital Markets based in Singapore, you will be responsible for driving origination efforts across the region by developing sustainable client relationships focused on flow-oriented primary market business. Your day-to-day activities will involve collaborating closely with relationship managers to provide comprehensive support on capital markets financing opportunities spanning multiple debt products and currencies. You will take ownership of structuring and executing complex debt transactions for issuance into diverse capital markets while managing all aspects of deal execution from due diligence through settlement. By partnering with distribution teams and other group entities globally, you will help deliver innovative solutions tailored to client needs. Your role also includes preparing impactful pitchbooks for client meetings, providing timely market updates, performing detailed analytical work for funding requirements, proactively creating trade ideas that address client needs, engaging directly with client teams for seamless execution, ensuring compliance standards are met at every stage of the process, and coordinating among stakeholders to guarantee successful outcomes. Success in this role requires a commitment to collaborative teamwork, attention to detail in analytical tasks, responsiveness to client enquiries in a risk-sensitive manner, and dedication to upholding the firm’s reputation.

- Develop and maintain sustainable, client-focused primary market origination business for clients across South and Southeast Asia by leveraging strong interpersonal skills.

- Work collaboratively with relationship managers to broaden overall relationships with core clients through high-quality support and product interface regarding capital markets financing opportunities.

- Originate, structure, and execute debt transactions for issuance into local, regional, or global capital markets while coordinating all aspects of deal execution including due diligence, documentation, ratings, investor marketing, roadshow planning, settlement, and case studies.

- Control workflow and operations across various debt products to ensure efficient delivery of services and maximise profitability by enhancing the customer franchise.

- Partner with distribution and sales teams to deliver tailored products that meet client needs while advancing the business globally through cross-entity collaboration.

- Prepare high-quality pitchbooks and materials for client meetings as well as follow-ups to ensure effective communication of proposals and solutions.

- Provide regular market updates and pricing information for internal and external stakeholders to keep them informed of relevant developments.

- Perform analytical work for client funding requirements including proactive pitching/marketing as well as responding to client RFPs with risk-sensitive solutions.

- Engage with client working-level teams to build relationships that facilitate smooth execution of transactions while ensuring compliance with AML/KYC standards.

- Coordinate between internal/external stakeholders and deal team members throughout the transaction lifecycle to protect and enhance the firm’s reputation.

What you bring:
The ideal candidate for the Vice President, Debt Capital Markets position brings extensive experience from banking or finance sectors—particularly within South or Southeast Asia—with proven expertise in debt capital markets origination or distribution. Your background should include substantial exposure to key ASEAN markets alongside strong analytical capabilities that enable precise evaluation of funding requirements. You possess deep knowledge of corporate lending practices complemented by credit analysis proficiency which enhances your ability to deliver tailored solutions. Your interpersonal strengths allow you to build dependable networks both internally among colleagues and externally with clients; these connections are vital for successful deal execution. You excel at stakeholder management through considerate collaboration across departments while your communication skills empower you to influence outcomes positively without compromising sensitivity or empathy. Your approach is marked by responsiveness—ensuring all proposed solutions align with best execution standards—and your commitment extends beyond technical expertise into nurturing relationships that foster trust throughout every stage of the transaction lifecycle.

- At least 7 years of experience in banking or finance demonstrating dependability in delivering results within complex environments.

- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience covering South or Southeast Asia markets; prior exposure to key ASEAN markets is required

- Demonstrated track record of at least 5 years in debt capital markets origination or distribution within the region showing commitment to collaborative success.

- Strong understanding or experience in corporate lending coupled with credit analysis skills which would be considered a significant advantage.

- Analytical background marked by meticulous attention to detail enabling accurate assessment of transactional requirements.

- Exceptional stakeholder management abilities allowing you to co-operate effectively across departments for optimal outcomes.

- Excellent inter-personal networking skills facilitating connection-building both internally among colleagues and externally with clients.

- Outstanding communication skills empowering you to influence others positively while maintaining sensitivity towards their perspectives.

- Ability to engage empathetically with clients’ working-level teams ensuring smooth execution of deals through nurturing relationships.

- Proven capacity for risk-sensitive decision-making when responding to client enquiries guaranteeing best execution practices.

What sets this company apart:
This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most respected financial institutions renowned for its commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace where collaboration thrives. Employees benefit from flexible working arrangements designed around individual needs as well as continuous training opportunities that encourage professional development at every stage of their career journey. The company’s supportive leadership structure ensures you have access to knowledgeable mentors who guide your growth while promoting communal values such as teamwork and shared success. With a strong emphasis on ethical conduct—especially regarding compliance standards—the firm prioritises protecting its reputation alongside yours. Here you’ll find an environment where your contributions are valued not only for their technical merit but also for how they enhance collective achievement; this makes it an ideal place for those seeking long-term career progression within a dependable network built on trust and mutual respect.

What's next:
If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in Debt Capital Markets while expanding your network within an inclusive team environment in Singapore—apply now!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided.
